lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12-14 high-contrast white vertical stripes of varying thickness. Spacing is significantly narrower in the anterior section (behind the shoulder) and widens as stripes progress toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 6th primary stripe from the neck, which splits into a Y-shape toward the dorsal boundary. A second branching point is visible on the posterior-most stripe near the pelvic region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple abbreviated segments are present, including a short dashed line between the 4th and 5th full stripes and several terminal segments in the lower mid-torso region that do not reach the ventral line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 8-10 distinct circular white spots is located on the lower posterior haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Four spots align in a near-horizontal geometric row traversing the mid-haunch, parallel to the ventral plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots are located on the cheek area below the eye. A dark, high-contrast terminal tuft is visible on the distal end of the tail.
